hits.term: Directs the Compiler to duplicate the source
hits.text:
Read or write routing back-annotation information
This option turns on advanced netlist optimization test mode.  For debugging only!!!.
Specifies a string argument for advanced netlist optimizations.
Directs the Compiler to duplicate the source node, and uses the new duplicate node to fan out to the destination node; the original source node no longer fans out to the destination node. Use the 'Value' field to specify the name of the duplicate node.
Directs the Compiler to create a number of duplicates of a register, including the original, and redistribute the fanouts of the original register among the duplicates.
Direct the Compiler to create a number of duplicates of a LUT/Register that drives synchronous control signals on RAM/DSP/Register, including the original, and redistribute the fanouts of the original register among the duplicates. Optionally specify the port_type argument with a case insensitive list of ports you wish to apply to. Options include: "DATA,ENABLE,READ_ADDRESS,WRITE_ADDRESS,SCLEAR,READ_ENABLE,WRITE_ENABLE,ADDRESS_STALL". A couple of valid examples are -port_type "DATA" and -port_type "DATA,READ_ADDRESS,ENABLE". If the port_type argument is not provided it will apply to all the supported ports by default.
Directs the Quartus Prime software to run in Incremental Placement Mode.
For user to override VCCIO current of SSTL2_CLASS1.
